desc:
Product description writing for online stores turns your product facts into clear text that helps shoppers decide and helps search engines understand each page. Ecom Swift LLC writes accurate descriptions in plain English, adds search titles and puts the text into your store.

## What makes a good product description?

A good product description answers the questions a shopper would ask a salesperson standing next to them. What is it? What is it made of? How big is it? Who is it for? How do I look after it? It does this in short, plain sentences, with the most useful facts first.

It is not a poem and it is not a list of adjectives. It gives enough detail that the buyer feels safe adding the item to the cart, and it matches what the product really is, so returns for "not as described" stay rare.

## Why copied or thin descriptions cost you

Many stores paste in the supplier's text. The same paragraph then appears on dozens of websites, and a search engine has no reason to prefer yours. Other stores leave a single line, which gives shoppers nothing to go on. In both cases the buyer's questions are unanswered, so they look elsewhere.

Text also supports everything around it. Product pages are read by shoppers, by Google and by AI answer tools that summarize products. Specific, factual sentences about materials, dimensions and use are the sentences those tools can quote. Vague hype gives them nothing to use.

## How descriptions influence conversions

Descriptions reduce doubt. A shopper looking at a jacket wants to know the fit, the lining, the weather it suits and how to wash it. If the page says so, the decision is easy. If it does not, the shopper leaves to find a page that does.

Good copy also lowers support work. Questions about size, compatibility or care that you answer on the page are questions you do not answer by email. And a short, well-written search title and meta description help the page earn a click from search results, since they are often the first words a buyer reads about your product.

## What strong product copy contains

- A first sentence that states plainly what the product is and what it does.
- Short feature bullets covering materials, dimensions and key specifications.
- Who the product suits and when to use it.
- Size, fit, care and compatibility details where they apply.
- Natural use of the words shoppers type into search, without repeating them unnaturally.
- A tone that matches your brand, such as friendly, practical or refined.
- Consistent structure across similar products, so shoppers know where to look.
- A search title and meta description for each page.
- Shorter variant notes where one option needs a special remark.
- No claims you cannot support.

## How we write for your store

We work from facts you provide: specification sheets, supplier details, your own notes and existing page text. Where a detail is missing, we ask you instead of guessing. Nothing is invented.

Before the full batch, we write a small sample in your chosen tone and send it for approval. Once you are happy, we write the rest, then add the text to your store if you want it published for you. The Basic package covers a small group of short descriptions. Standard adds feature bullets, search titles and meta descriptions, and size, care and material details. Premium covers a larger set, introductions for a few collections, short variant copy, a one-page brand voice guide you can reuse and upload to your store.

We write in our own words and do not copy supplier text.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Lead with the facts a shopper needs most.
- Keep sentences short and concrete.
- Give measurements in the units your customers use.
- Use the same structure for products in the same range.
- Read the text aloud, as a customer would hear it.

**Avoid:**
- Pasting manufacturer descriptions unchanged.
- Piling up adjectives with no detail behind them.
- Making health, safety or performance claims you cannot prove.
- Repeating the same keyword in every sentence.

## Who this service is for

It suits a new store owner with a hundred products and no time to write. It suits an established seller whose pages share supplier text with competitors. It also suits a brand that wants a consistent voice across a growing catalog and needs a guide the team can follow.

## What we need from you

Send product details: spec sheets, supplier files, measurements, materials and any notes about your customers. Tell us the tone you like and give an example of copy you admire if you have one. We ask for collaborator or staff access only if you want us to add the text to your store, and we never need your password.
